questions.hint: The book is on the table.
questions.explain: на + prepositional: a noun ending in a consonant adds -е.

questions.hint: Yesterday we were at a concert.
questions.explain: Events and activities take на: на концерте, на уроке, на работе.

questions.hint: They live in a big house.
questions.explain: Masculine adjective -ом, noun -е: в большом доме.
почта is an на-word, and location (где?) needs the prepositional: на почте.
After a preposition она becomes ней: о ней.

questions.hint: Our office is in this building.

questions.explain: Feminine adjective in the prepositional: -ой (в новой квартире).
Some masculine nouns take a stressed -у after в / на: в лесу, в саду, в аэропорту.

questions.prompt: Мой брат долго жил в разных ___.
questions.hint: My brother lived in different countries for a long time.
We went to Moscow last year.
questions.explain: в … году: adjective -ом, and год takes the stressed -у.
при (in front of, in the presence of) + prepositional: при детях.

questions.prompt: We often talk about our children.
answer: Мы часто говорим о наших детях.
Мы часто говорим о своих детях.
Мы часто разговариваем о наших детях.
Мы часто разговариваем о своих детях.
questions.explain: о + prepositional plural: наши дети → о наших детях (свой is also fine).
